law: An alias supplies only which repository name to search under. The reconciler still computes the state from what that search finds, so an alias can never promote a row on its own, and an alias that stops resolving fails the compile rather than silently reverting the row to MISSING. Every entry below was checked against the tree: the named module exists and implements the section's mechanism, not merely a similar phrase.

The Personal Civilization canon calls this the Life Knowledge Graph; it connects people, projects, decisions, goals and events with provenance on every edge.

truthBoundary: These are reviewed name mappings, not evidence. A section aliased to a module with no test still reports PARTIAL, and nothing here grants authority.
